description: Shared Renovate preset for JasonSooter repos. Extend with: { "extends": ["local>JasonSooter/renovate-config"] }

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the weekly schedule. OSV (above) covers direct dependencies only; this reads the repo's Dependabot alerts, which cover transitive ones too. Dependabot alerts are on; its security and version updates are off.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly lockfile refresh, so transitive dependencies with open ranges pick up patches without waiting on a direct bump.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every non-major update; majors stay separate so each gets its own review.
